what_it_says: Former Moscow drama troupe actor; provincial actor, director and scene-painter; wrote stories and verse.
remark: Was a 'декораторъ' in provincial drama theatres; no ballet named.

what_it_says: Double-bass then cello player in the orchestra of the German / Mikhailovsky theatre, 1833-1855.
remark: Orchestra is that of the German theatre at the Mikhailovsky; no ballet or opera-and-ballet orchestra stated.

what_it_says: Repertoire inspector (1864), commission member (1872) and manager (1881-82) of the Moscow Imperial Theatres; playwright and translator.
remark: Core by office only (administrator over the Moscow theatres, which include the ballet); the text never uses the word ballet and lists no ballet libretto. Look-alike: «Жаръ-птица», ком. is a comedy, not a ballet. If office alone does not qualify, this is none.

what_it_says: Moscow drama troupe actor from 1888; a few roles named.
Violinist of the Mikhailovsky theatre orchestra from 1876.
remark: Mikhailovsky orchestra only; no ballet stated.

what_it_says: Chorister of the Moscow opera troupe from 1865.

ballet_quote_verbatim: къ балету «Царь Кандавлъ» (Дикая мѣстность близъ пещеры сардійской пиѳіи—1-ая картина 1-го дѣйствія и Станъ царя Кандавла—2-ая картина 1-го дѣйствія)
what_it_says: Scene painter of the St Petersburg Imperial Theatres from 1891; painted two scenes for the ballet Tsar Kandavl, plus opera and comedy sets.
remark: Entry runs p.475-476.

what_it_says: Contralto of the St Petersburg Russian opera troupe; opera roles only.
remark: Look-alike: Княгиня («Русалка») is the opera.

ballet_quote_verbatim: артистъ С.-Петербургской балетной труппы ... не оставляя должности танцовщика, Н. И. назначенъ былъ учителемъ балетныхъ танцевъ въ младшемъ классѣ Театральнаго Училища
what_it_says: St Petersburg ballet dancer, trained at the Theatre School; from 1863 teacher of ballet dancing in its junior class; left the ballet 1884 to teach full time.
remark: Entry runs p.476-477.

what_it_says: Flautist of the Alexandrinsky then Mikhailovsky theatre orchestra from 1887.
remark: Drama-theatre orchestras only; no ballet stated.

ballet_quote_verbatim: артистка Московской балетной труппы ... По выходѣ изъ Училища, будучи опредѣлена на службу въ Московскую балетную труппу, Л. Н. получила разрѣшеніе вступить въ составъ ученицъ драматическихъ курсовъ Училища
what_it_says: Moscow ballet troupe artist (Moscow Theatre School, 1889) who showed dramatic talent, took the drama courses (1892), acted in Rostov-on-Don under the name Радина; died of cholera 1892.
remark: Entry runs p.477-478. Look-alike noted: роль Русалочки въ оперѣ «Русалка» is a child role in the opera.

what_it_says: Deacon of the church of the St Petersburg Theatre School; for a time taught church singing to the School's girl pupils.
remark: Borderline: Theatre School staff («обучалъ церковному пѣнію воспитанницъ Училища») but clergy, not an administrator; no dance or ballet named.

what_it_says: French troupe (Mikhailovsky) actor 1860-1877; Paris career, roles, farewell benefit 2 April 1877 with medal and gifts.
remark: Entry runs p.478-480. At the benefit «всѣ труппы почтили его депутаціями и вѣнками» - ballet troupe not named, so not counted. «Odette» is a Sardou play.

what_it_says: Painter in the property workshop then assistant scene-painter of the St Petersburg Imperial Theatres from 1887.
remark: Assistant decorator; no production of any kind (ballet or other) is named.

what_it_says: St Petersburg Russian drama actor in secondary roles from 1874.
remark: «Воспитывался въ С.-Петербургскомъ Театральномъ Училищѣ» - department not stated; released straight into the drama troupe.

what_it_says: Former St Petersburg drama actor: chorister of the German troupe 1857, then prompter, assistant director, minor roles; later private and provincial stages.
remark: Entry runs p.480-481. Theatre School graduate, department not stated; released as a chorister.

what_it_says: Chorister of the St Petersburg Russian opera from 1877.
Chorister of the St Petersburg Russian opera from 1885.
Soprano of the Moscow opera 1881-83, daughter and pupil of the singer A. D. Alexandrova-Kochetova; later sang in Italy and Spain.
remark: Entry runs p.481-482. Opera roles only.

what_it_says: Clerk of the St Petersburg Office of the Imperial Theatres from 1874; superintendent of the Mikhailovsky theatre 1880-82; 'journalist' (registrar) of the Office from 1883.
remark: Office clerk; no authority over the ballet or the Theatre School stated.

what_it_says: Chorister of the St Petersburg Russian opera 1858-84, also minor comic bass solo parts.
remark: Entry runs p.482-483.

what_it_says: Violinist: first violin of the Mikhailovsky orchestra 1835, from 1843 in the Italian opera orchestra, later its first concertmaster; taught at the Court Chapel. Son of L.-W. Maurer, conductor of the French orchestra and inspector of music.
remark: Orchestras named are Mikhailovsky and Italian opera only; ballet not mentioned for him or his father.

ballet_quote_verbatim: бывшій балетмейстеръ С.-Петербургскихъ Императорскихъ театровъ ... Вступивъ 7-го декабря этого года на службу Дирекціи, въ балетную труппу, сначала въ качествѣ танцовщика ... поставленные имъ балеты «Эсмеральда» (21-го декабря 1848 года) и «Катарина, дочь разбойника» (4-го февраля 1849 года)
what_it_says: Ballet master of the St Petersburg Imperial Theatres 1848-1860: dancer, mime and choreographer; full list of his ballets with dates, his 28 roles, court divertissements, the 1851 Peterhof fete and 1856 coronation festivities.
remark: Entry runs p.484-486 (three images), read to the end.

what_it_says: Assistant inspector of repertoire and secretary to the director of the Moscow Imperial Theatres 1854-58; playwright/translator of over 100 plays; co-founder of the Moscow Artistic Circle; choral-singing classes; 50-year jubilee 1891.
remark: Entry runs p.486-487. Repertoire-office post in Moscow, but no ballet, dancer or ballet libretto is mentioned; jubilee described without any programme. Footnote points to the play list (row 1).

what_it_says: Cellist of the Italian opera orchestra from 1852 (Theatre School graduate); conductor of the Smolny / Alexandrovskoe school orchestra; from 1877 head of the Music Office (Central Music Library); soloist in performances and at Court.
remark: Borderline: «Воспитывался въ С.-Петербургскомъ Театральномъ Училищѣ» (department not stated, released as a musician) and «исполнялъ обязанности солиста въ спектакляхъ» / «solo въ Красносельскомъ театрѣ» - kind of performance not stated, ballet never named.

what_it_says: St Petersburg (and briefly Moscow) drama troupe actress 1872-83, chiefly operetta leads, also comedy and vaudeville.
remark: Text wraps both sides of the portrait; read both columns. Look-alike: Мефистофель—«Фаустъ наизнанку» is an operetta.

what_it_says: St Petersburg drama actor 1872-74 and 1882-83, otherwise provincial and private stages.
Violist of the Alexandrinsky theatre orchestra from 1874, ex-military musician.
remark: Drama-theatre orchestra only.

ballet_quote_verbatim: поступилъ на службу Дирекціи солистомъ-віолончелистомъ Московскаго балетнаго оркестра и вскорѣ былъ перемѣщенъ въ составъ оркестра Московской оперы
what_it_says: Saxon cellist: joined in 1862 as solo cellist of the Moscow ballet orchestra, soon moved to the Moscow opera orchestra; briefly professor at the Moscow Conservatoire; left 1890.
Chorister of the Moscow opera troupe from 1882.

ballet_quote_verbatim: поступилъ учителемъ русской словесности, литературы и декламаціи на женской половинѣ балетнаго отдѣленія Училища
what_it_says: Teacher at the Moscow Theatre School for nearly 20 years: from 1873 Russian language, literature and declamation in the girls' half of the ballet department; from 1888 also history of drama and theatre on the drama courses; honorary member of the School's conference.
remark: Not a dance teacher or administrator, but taught ballet-department pupils and was «почетный членъ конференціи» of the Theatre School; could be read as core if conference membership counts as school administration.

entry_heading_as_printed: Тарновскій, К. А. (Списокъ драматическихъ произведеній К. А. Тарновскаго)
what_it_says: Alphabetical list of Tarnovsky's 103 original and translated plays with genre and number of acts.
remark: List runs p.520-521; all 103 items read. Genres are ком., вод., др., сц., интерм., оперетка, волшебство, предст. - no ballet. Look-alikes: 54) «Мраморныя красавицы», др. (cf. Perrot's ballet «Мраморная красавица»); 83) «Райская птичка», фантаст. предст.; 57) and 62) are «волшебство»; 38) «Итальянская ночь», интерм.
